name: Identifying the Brood
summary: In Brackenwall Village, Draz'Zilb seeks the beast that attacked the clan's old home. Draz'Zilb says Mok'Morokk clings to power while Tharg struggles with sorrow and vengeance, and asks you for fifteen searing tongues and fifteen searing hearts.

sections.title: A Voice of Reason
sections.body: Draz'Zilb says Mok'Morokk is consumed by power while Tharg wrestles with sorrow and a thirst for vengeance. In Draz'Zilb's view, no one else is trying to learn who attacked the clan's old home. The ogre speaks with care, though you might have expected a brute's words.

sections.title: Hearts and Tongues
sections.body:
Draz'Zilb asks you to take fifteen tongues and fifteen hearts from the whelps and hatchlings. The burned young belong to the black dragon army, and Draz'Zilb hopes their remains will reveal which beast sent her young into the ogres' home.

If the ogres learn what kind of beast they face, they may destroy their enemy for good and reclaim Stonemaul Village from ruin. Draz'Zilb says getting Mok'Morokk to leave the swamp will be a great labor of its own.

faq.answer: Draz'Zilb is an ogre in Brackenwall Village who speaks formally rather than like a brute. Draz'Zilb wants to learn who attacked the clan's old home.

faq.q: What does Draz'Zilb want from the whelps and hatchlings?
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb asks for fifteen searing tongues and fifteen searing hearts from the whelps and hatchlings. Their remains may reveal which beast sent her young into the old home.

faq.q: What does Draz'Zilb think of the clan's leaders?
faq.answer: Draz'Zilb has little respect for Mok'Morokk, whom the ogre calls a craven fool consumed by power. Draz'Zilb sees Tharg as caught in sorrow and a thirst for revenge.

attribution: Classic quest text: Identifying the Brood
